{{Capricorn}}
Capricorn 21 is the 49th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 21st day of Capricorn, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 7, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 2宮21日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 49|Chapter 49]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152069}}.

===Chapter summary===
As Stomatos’ sons multiplied across the continents, King Hirnan united them in conquest, seizing land and driving trilobites to their doom. His descendants gave rise to mosses, hornworts, ferns, and flowering plants, but his empire poisoned the seas with phosphorus, causing mass extinctions. The golden Ordovician age ended in devastation as Leviathans, Krakens, and trilobites fell. Yet from ruin arose the Silurian dawn, carrying lessons that greed destroys while harmony and love renew life’s hope.
